Lower Text: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Trash the top card of both players' decks.
Upper Text: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Evil] or [Fallen Angel] trait and 1 card with the [Seven Great Demon Lords] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, trash 1 card in your hand.
